metadata.title: Glimm, Bhat & Newman (2014) Dev. Biol. 395:139-149 & Ho et al. (2019) PLoS Biol. 17:e3000132 Avian Feather Bud Hexagonal Array & Traveling Competence Wave Reference Dataset

sources.citation: Glimm T, Bhat R, Newman SA (2014). Modeling happens in rows: Traveling waves in dermal condensation of avian feather primordia. Developmental Biology 395(1):139-149.
Ho WKW, Freem L, Zhao D, Painter KJ, Woolley TE, Gaffney EA, et al. (2019). Feather arrays are patterned by interacting signaling and mechanical waves. PLOS Biology 17(2):e3000132.
Michon F, Forest L, Collomb E, Demongeot J, Dhouailly D (2008). BMP2 and BMP7 Play Antagonistic Roles in Feather Primordium Formation: A Mechanistic Model. PLOS ONE 3(4):e1942.

Bailleul R, Curantz C, Desmarquet-Trin Dinh C, Hidalgo M, Touboul J, Manceau M (2019). Symmetry breaking in the embryonic skin triggers directional and sequential plumage patterning. PLOS Biology 17(10):e3000448.

chick_feather_bud_hexagonal_specimen.species: Gallus gallus (Embryonic chick E6.5+24h to E6.5+48h dorsal skin feather tract whole-mount CTNNB1/EDAR/EDA in situ hybridization and high-magnification 60-deg hexagonal feather bud lattice)
chick_feather_bud_hexagonal_specimen.author: William K. W. Ho, Kevin J. Painter, Thomas E. Woolley, Denis J. Headon et al. (PLOS Biology 17(2):e3000132, 2019, Fig. 3)

governing_equations.section: Glimm, Bhat & Newman (2014) Dev. Biol. 395:139-149 & Ho et al. (2019) PLoS Biol. 17:e3000132 (Coupled Keller-Segel Dermal Chemotaxis + FGF20/BMP4 Lateral Inhibition + Mediolateral EDA Traveling Competence Wave)
governing_equations.dermal_cell_density_pde: dn/dt = D_n * Lap(n) - chi * div(n * grad(c)) + r_n * n * (1 - n / K_n)
governing_equations.fgf20_chemoattractant_pde: dc/dt = D_c * Lap(c) + s_w(x, t) * alpha_c * n^2 / ((1 + beta_b * b) * (1 + kappa_c * n^2)) - mu_c * c
governing_equations.bmp4_inhibitor_pde: db/dt = D_b * Lap(b) + s_w(x, t) * alpha_b * n^2 - mu_b * b
governing_equations.boundary_conditions: Periodic along anteroposterior axis y in [0, L_y], zero-flux Neumann along mediolateral axis x in [-L_x/2, L_x/2]

linear_stability_and_geometry_invariants.keller_segel_chemotactic_threshold: chi * n_0 * f_c > D_n * mu_c (supercritical FGF20 chemotaxis required for dermal condensation; chi = 0 in scaleless FGF20-/- or Latrunculin mechanical blockade yields uniform stability)
linear_stability_and_geometry_invariants.traveling_wave_hexagonal_locking: Sequential row-by-row competence propagation at moderate wave speed v_w templates each new row r+1 into the BMP4 inhibitory saddles at half-period offset Delta_y = lambda_y / 2 of row r, achieving crystalline hexagonal packing P_6 >= 0.85 vs defective polycrystalline Voronoi packing P_6 <= 0.55 under simultaneous global competence (v_w -> inf).

wild_type_traveling_wave.description: Ho et al. (2019) Figs. 1B, 3A-B, 4C-D & Glimm et al. (2014) Figs. 3-5: Bilateral EDA/mechanical competence wave advancing mediolaterally at optimal wave speed v_w = 0.22 grid/step templates sequential staggered rows at Delta_y = lambda_y / 2 and Delta_x = (sqrt(3)/2)*lambda_y, yielding a near-defect-free hexagonal feather bud array (P_6 >= 0.85, |psi_6| >= 0.82).

simultaneous_global_competence_fc_eda1.description: Ho et al. (2019) Figs. 1C (FGF-medium), 3D-E (Fc-chEDA1 global EDA flooding) & Glimm et al. (2014) Fig. 6: Instantaneous global competence (v_w -> inf) nucleates feather buds simultaneously across the entire dorsal skin without row-by-row phase pinning, producing a polycrystalline array rich in 5-7 topological defects (P_6 approx 0.45-0.55).

ecto_d2_bmp_narrowed_wave.description: Ho et al. (2019) Figs. 3D-I (Ecto-D2 EDA decoy receptor / LDN): Retarded competence wave speed (v_w = 0.11, 0.5x WT) restricts feather bud initiation to a narrowed medial tract (~0.55-0.65x WT tract width) while preserving local hexagonal row ordering within the patterned core.

scaleless_fgf20_null_mutant.description: Ho et al. (2019) Fig. 1 & Hughes et al. (2018) (scaleless sc/sc mutant lacking functional FGF20): Loss of chemotactic FGF20 signaling (chi = 0.0 < chi_c) abolishes dermal mesenchymal condensation across the dorsal tract (0 feather buds).

latrunculin_mechanical_blockade.description: Ho et al. (2019) Fig. 1C, F, G (Latrunculin A / Blebbistatin actomyosin cell-motility blockade): Suppressing mesenchymal traction and motility (chi = 0.01 < chi_c, elevated damping) prevents cell clustering and abolishes discrete FGF20/BMP4 spots (0 feather buds).
